text_block_list.text:
I'm still shaking, that was so crazy... But I
did it!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I beat Tamamo!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Whoooa! City beat the Тамамо Кросс?!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Amazing! I hope she runs even more
gorgeously
next year!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
In other words, you don't care about my
results?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It's too bad about Тамамо Кросс, but
wow, did
she put up a fight!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Тамамо Кросс might be a late bloomer,
but she'll
be even stronger next year for
it! We gotta keep
an eye on her through
her senior year!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Isn't that nice? All they talk about is her

performance.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Even though I'm the one who won. I'm the one who's stronger.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Haha... Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Why did I even bother?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: What a waste of time.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: City...
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text: Hey! What's da big idea?!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Weren't ya listenin' when I said don't
half-ass it
out dere?!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
But I didn't... I won against you, fair and
square.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Dat's not what I mean and ya know it!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Tch... Fine! Be a little crybaby, then!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
And here I thought ya wanted to show
everyone
ya got backbone!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Hmph... Guess I'll ask ya one more time.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: What're ya racing for?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Why do ya run?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: ...Isn't it obvious?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Don't look down! Look me in da eyes!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Unreal. Don't tell me I got my hopes up
for dis...
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Whatever... It's not like anything I say'd
make a
difference. I lost.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: ...Why couldn't I say anything?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh well... who cares? Not like any of it
even
matters.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Trainer. I'm done.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: There's no point to running anymore.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
People will always look at me the same,
no matter
how well I do.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I thought things would change if I
showed them
my ability. That's why I
worked so hard.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: But it was all just wishful thinking.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
People only care about "Pretty City." My
running
means nothing to them.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
All my effort until now has been
pointless. And it
will keep being
pointless.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: So I... just don't care anymore.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити looks defeated. Maybe having
her
compete in the Arima Kinen was a
bad idea.

But there's one thing I need to confirm
before I
let regret take over.

She doesn't say anything. But that
silence is all I
need to hear.
choice_data_list: (There's no way City wants to quit!)

text_block_list.text:
She's just letting out what's been pent
up all this
time. The only thing I can do
is continue
preparing her for the road
she's chosen.
I'm getting changed. Leave, please.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: ...What?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

running
anymore?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

you need
me there for the sign-up

If you want to make me run so bad, then
go
ahead.

changed.
